Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 144. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 30
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Max Power Energy Wave
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 60 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
Fire a ferocious beam of energy with the full force of
your Ki. Make a Beam attack roll dealing a number of
d10 equal to your wisdom modifier.
